subject: Geopolitics
title: Can Truth Win?
description: A short lesson to help you apply Can Truth Win?.

hook.text: A study found that 86% of people believe they can spot fake news. The actual detection rate is under 50%.

buildup.text: Truth depends on institutions: free press, independent courts, and transparent government.

discovery.text: When trust in institutions collapses, truth becomes tribal. People believe their side's version and reject all others.

twist.text: But history shows recoveries. Watergate's truth emerged. Soviet propaganda collapsed.

climax.text: Truth doesn't win automatically. It requires investment, courage, and institutions willing to defend it.

punchline.text: Truth doesn't win by default. It wins by effort.

quiz.question: What is needed for truth to prevail over disinformation?
options: Strong institutions, free press, and civic investment
